notes.title: Update notes for June
notes.content:
It's the start of winter or summer and whatever the season, it's the best time for cheese!

This update will fix the issue with the puzzle achievement. Finish off all 12 levels, it's tricky. 
Let us know if you have any further issues, we are more than happy to look into and fix if needed.
If you have any further ideas or suggestions, we'd love to hear those as well.

notes.title: Update notes for 13th february
notes.content:
With the latest update we have fixed various bugs and made improvements.
[list]
[*] Fixed level blockages. Cheese spawned in match orders in story mode.
[*] Added hint mechanic to highlight cheese behind smoke in smoke levels.
[*] Fixed more ghost cheese.
[*] Fixed cheese in levels spawning in and out on start up.
[*] Fixed mould/blue special cheese tool cheese from spawning ghost tools (otherwise known as tool specials that don't always go off.)
[*] Fixed wrong score shown on game end screen. Steam leaderboard will now match in story mode.
[*] and more.
[/list]
We hope you have a special valentines day, don't forget the cheese.

notes.title: Update notes for 19th January
notes.content:
Small patch update for fix to a level in chapter 6 story mode.

We are working on getting a few more fixes out this upcoming week.

Thanks to all who have reported issues and bugs.

notes.title: Update notes for jan 4th
notes.content: We've released a small patch fix for an issue with cheese that would double and wouldn't match which can be frustrating. While the extra cheese did resolve itself on a next action and was rare, we want players to have the best playing experience possible.

notes.title: Cheese party is released on steam.
notes.content:
[h3]We hope you enjoy our first game Cheese Party. [/h3]

A little past our original release date. Lessons learnt; [olist]
[*]  Don't release near your wedding anniversary.
[*] It's crazy to release so close to christmas.
[*] Expect a heatwave on your original release date. 
[/olist]

We intend to keep the game updated and new content to come. 

For now we need to christmas and fix bugs.

[i]Season's greetings,[/i]
Raincode
